data.name: Victariel
data.long_meaning: The name Victariel is derived from the Latin word 'victor', meaning 'conqueror', and the prefix 'ariel' which has a Hebrew origin meaning 'lion of God'. This combination suggests someone who conquers God or is like a divine lion. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the belief that through faith and trust in God, one can overcome adversity and triumph.
